summary.zh: 新增 opinion_manager.py migrate：把用户现有的 Opinion（Profile 2.0 / 2.1）迁移到标签选择加载。默认预览（零写入，失败路径也一样），--apply --confirm <指纹> 才写入；写入前备份到 .opinion/backups/<时间戳>-migrate/ 并写 manifest，复用 profile → compose → verify 的原子写与读回，失败按备份逐字节还原；--rollback 只在当前状态等于迁移后状态时还原。用户的 custom 段与手工追加的内容原样保留、常驻，不替用户猜标签；2.1 默认不动，--tags 才改用标签。另新增 catalog 1.1.0 的体积守卫测试。既有项目不会自动变化。
summary.en: Add opinion_manager.py migrate: migrate a user's existing Opinion (Profile 2.0 / 2.1) to tag-based loading. It previews by default (nothing is written, failure paths included) and writes only with --apply --confirm <fingerprint>; before writing it backs up to .opinion/backups/<timestamp>-migrate/ with a manifest, reuses the atomic profile → compose → verify write and read-back, and restores the backup byte for byte on failure; --rollback restores only while the current state still equals the migrated state. The user's custom section and hand-written additions are kept as written and always loaded; no tags are guessed for the user. 2.1 stays untouched unless --tags is given. Also adds a size-budget test for catalog 1.1.0. Existing projects do not change automatically.

user_action_required.what: 可选：运行 opinion_manager.py migrate --project <项目> 查看迁移预览，确认后加 --apply --confirm <指纹> 写入；不迁移则保持原样（2.1 项目要改用标签再加 --tags）；写入前自动备份，可用 --rollback 回滚
